source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice long questions written from Chapter 6 (PDF 119-138), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 6 (Heat and Thermodynamics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har 5 number ke theory sawal (definition, wazahat, derivation) ke baad usi mauzu ka 3 number ka numerical hai. Har sawal ka model jawab hai; numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 What is the kinetic theory of gases? Explain its assumptions about the motion, volume, forces and collisions of gas particles, and how it accounts for pressure and temperature. Why do real gases not obey these assumptions exactly? (5 marks)
(Kinetic theory of gases kya hai? Gas ke zarraat ki harkat, volume, forces aur takkar ke baare mein is ke mafroozat bayan karein, aur yeh pressure aur temperature ki wazahat kaise karti hai. Real gases in mafroozat ki poori pairwi kyun nahi karti?)
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory: aik buniyadi theory jo gas ke rawayye ko us ke zarraat (particles) ki harkat se samjhati hai aur pressure, temperature aur volume ko is harkat se jorti hai.

Mafroozat:
1. Musalsal be-tarteeb harkat: molecules hamesha random harkat mein hain aur takkar tak seedhi lakeer mein chalte hain.
2. Na-qabil-e-lehaaz volume: alag molecules ka volume gas ke kul volume ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar hai, is liye woh point masses hain.
3. Koi intermolecular force nahi: takkar ke siwa molecules aik doosre par kashish ya dhakka nahi lagate.
4. Elastic takkar: molecules ki aapas mein aur deewaron se takkar perfectly elastic hai; kul kinetic energy mehfooz rehti hai.
5. Zarraat ki bari tadaad: is se statistical tareeqe istemal ho sakte hain.
6. Average K.E. ∝ absolute temperature: temperature barhne se zarraat ki speed barhti hai.
7. Pressure: deewaron se takrane wale zarraat ki force pressure paida karti hai.
8. Takkar ka waqt do takkaron ke darmiyani waqt ke muqable mein na hone ke barabar hai.

Jo gas in mafroozat ki pairwi kare woh ideal gas hai; us ki equation of state PV = nRT ... (6.1), R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹.

Had (real gases): real gases intermolecular forces aur molecules ke mehdood volume ki wajah se, khaas taur par zyada pressure aur kam temperature par, hat-ti hain. Kam pressure aur zyada temperature par woh ideal rawayye ke qareeb aati hain.

book_ref.quote: Here are the key assumptions of the kinetic theory of gases.

blocks.prompt:
2 A cylinder of volume 0.020 m³ contains oxygen at 27 °C and 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa. Treating oxygen as an ideal gas (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, molar mass 0.032 kg mol⁻¹), find (i) the number of moles (ii) the mass of oxygen. (3 marks)
(0.020 m³ ke cylinder mein 27 °C aur 2.0 × 10⁵ Pa par oxygen hai. Oxygen ko ideal gas maan kar (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, molar mass 0.032 kg mol⁻¹) (i) moles ki tadaad (ii) oxygen ka mass nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Temperature ko kelvin mein badlein, PV = nRT se n nikalein, phir mass = n × molar mass.

book_ref.quote: Ideal gas equation is given by

blocks.prompt:
3 Starting from PV = nRT, express the ideal gas equation in terms of the number of molecules N. Define the Boltzmann constant, find its value, and write the meaning of each symbol in the final equation. (5 marks)
(PV = nRT se shuru kar ke ideal gas equation ko molecules ki tadaad N ki shakal mein likhein. Boltzmann constant ki definition likhein, us ki qeemat nikalein, aur aakhri equation ke har symbol ka matlab likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ideal gas equation:
PV = nRT ... (i)
Yahan n moles ki tadaad hai, yani atoms ya molecules ki tadaad N fi Avogadro's number Nₐ (Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³):
n = N/Nₐ ... (ii)
(ii) ko (i) mein rakhne se:
PV = (N/Nₐ)RT ... (iii)

Boltzmann constant: R/Nₐ ko Boltzmann constant k_B kehte hain:
k_B = R/Nₐ ... (6.2)
Qeemat: k_B = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ / 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹

(6.2) ko (iii) mein rakhne se:
PV = N k_B T ... (6.3)
Yeh Boltzmann constant ki shakal mein ideal gas equation hai. P = pressure, V = volume, N = molecules ki tadaad, k_B = Boltzmann constant, T = absolute temperature.

book_ref.quote: Substituting the values of R and Nₐ, we have

blocks.prompt:
4 Two moles of an ideal gas are at 350 K and a pressure of 2.0 atm (1 atm = 101325 Pa). Using k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ and Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹, find (i) the number of molecules (ii) the volume of the gas. (3 marks)
(Ideal gas ke 2 moles 350 K aur 2.0 atm pressure par hain (1 atm = 101325 Pa). k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ aur Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³ mol⁻¹ le kar (i) molecules ki tadaad (ii) gas ka volume nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: N = nNₐ nikalein, phir PV = N k_B T se V nikalein.

book_ref.quote: One mole of an ideal gas is at a temperature of 300 K.

blocks.prompt:
5 What are gas laws? For a fixed mass of an ideal gas, show how Boyle's law, Charles' law and Gay-Lussac's law each relate two of P, V and T when the third is kept constant. Write each law mathematically and describe its graph. (5 marks)
(Gas laws kya hain? Ideal gas ki muqarrara miqdaar ke liye dikhayein ke Boyle's law, Charles' law aur Gay-Lussac's law teesre ko sabit rakh kar P, V aur T mein se do ko kaise jorte hain. Har qanoon riyazi shakal mein likhein aur us ka graph bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Gas laws: pressure, volume aur temperature (state functions) gas ki miqdaar bayan karte hain. Aik variable badalne se doosra badalta hai jabke teesra sabit rehta hai. Ideal gas ke in variables ko jorne wale qawaneen gas laws hain.

Boyle's law (Robert Boyle, 1662): sabit temperature par ideal gas ki muqarrara miqdaar ka pressure volume ke ulat mutanasib hai.
P ∝ 1/V (T sabit)
P = constant × 1/V, ya PV = constant
P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
Graph (Fig. 6.1): P aur V ka graph aik curve hai; V barhne par P kam hota hai.

Charles' law (Jacques Charles, taqreeban 1787): sabit pressure par gas ki di gayi miqdaar ka volume us ke absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai.
V ∝ T (P sabit)
V/T = constant, ya V₁/T₁ = V₂/T₂
Graph (Fig. 6.2): V aur T ka graph seedhi lakeer hai.

Gay-Lussac's law: sabit volume par ideal gas ki muqarrara miqdaar ka pressure absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai.
P ∝ T (V sabit)
P/T = constant, ya P₁/T₁ = P₂/T₂
Graph (Fig. 6.3): P aur T ka graph seedhi lakeer hai.

Teeno PV = nRT se mutabiqat rakhte hain: muqarrara n ke liye PV, T ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai.

book_ref.quote: with change in one variable, the second variable changes while the third is kept constant

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka aasaan tareeqa: jo cheez sabit ho us ka naam qanoon ke saath jorein. Boyle = T sabit (P aur V ulte), Charles = P sabit (V aur T seedhe), Gay-Lussac = V sabit (P aur T seedhe). Har sawal mein temperature hamesha kelvin mein lein.

blocks.prompt:
6 A fixed mass of gas occupies 10 L at 2.0 atm and 300 K. It is first heated at constant pressure to 360 K, and then compressed at constant temperature to 8.0 L. Find (i) the volume after heating (ii) the final pressure. (3 marks)
(Gas ki muqarrara miqdaar 2.0 atm aur 300 K par 10 L gherti hai. Pehle use sabit pressure par 360 K tak garam kiya jata hai, phir sabit temperature par 8.0 L tak dabaya jata hai. (i) garam karne ke baad volume (ii) aakhri pressure nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Pehla qadam sabit pressure par hai (Charles' law); doosra sabit temperature par (Boyle's law).

book_ref.quote: Charles' law relates volume and temperature of an ideal gas for a fixed mass at constant pressure.

steps: Boyle's law (T = 360 K sabit): P₂V₂ = P₃V₃

blocks.prompt:
7 Under what conditions does a real gas behave like an ideal gas? Starting from PV = nRT, derive an expression for the density of an ideal gas and use it to explain these conditions. (5 marks)
(Real gas kin halaat mein ideal gas ki tarah rawayya rakhti hai? PV = nRT se shuru kar ke ideal gas ki density ka formula nikalein aur us se yeh halaat samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Kinetic theory ke mutabiq ideal gas mein molecules ka aapas mein koi taamul nahi aur woh door door hote hain. Real gas ideal ki tarah tab chalti hai jab us ke molecules ki P.E. na hone ke barabar ho aur sirf K.E. ho.

Derivation: PV = nRT ... (6.1) mein moles ki tadaad
n = gas ka mass/molar mass = m/M
Is liye PV = (m/M)RT, ya PM = (m/V)RT
Chunke density ρ = m/V:
PM = ρRT, is liye ρ = PM/RT
Di gayi gas ke liye M/R sabit hai:
ρ ∝ P/T

Wazahat: kam pressure aur zyada temperature par gas ki density kam hoti hai. Us waqt molecules aik doosre se bohat door hote hain aur intermolecular forces na hone ke barabar hoti hain. Is liye real gas kam pressure aur zyada temperature par ideal gas ki tarah rawayya rakhti hai.

Zyada pressure aur kam temperature par density zyada, molecules qareeb, intermolecular forces aur molecules ka mehdood volume aham ho jaate hain, aur gas ideal rawayye se hat jaati hai.

book_ref.quote: According to kinetic theory of gases, a gas has no intermolecular interaction

blocks.prompt:
8 Treating nitrogen (molar mass 0.028 kg mol⁻¹) as an ideal gas, find its density at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa (i) at 280 K (ii) at 560 K. (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹) (3 marks)
(Nitrogen (molar mass 0.028 kg mol⁻¹) ko ideal gas maan kar 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa par us ki density nikalein (i) 280 K par (ii) 560 K par. (R = 8.3145 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹))
blocks.explanation: ρ = PM/RT lagayein; usi pressure par T dugna karne se ρ aadhi hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: So, the real gas behaves like an ideal gas at low pressure and high temperature.

steps: Jaanch: sabit P par ρ ∝ 1/T, is liye ρ₂ = ρ₁/2

blocks.prompt:
9 Define internal energy. Explain why the internal energy of an ideal gas is directly proportional to its absolute temperature, using the kinetic theory result for the average kinetic energy of a molecule. Why is internal energy called a function of state? (5 marks)
(Internal energy ki definition likhein. Molecule ki average kinetic energy ke kinetic theory wale nateeje se samjhayein ke ideal gas ki internal energy us ke absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib kyun hai. Internal energy ko function of state kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: kisi maadde ki tamam molecular energies (kinetic aur potential) ka majmooa us ki internal energy hai.

Ideal gas: thermodynamics mein aam tor par ideal gas working substance hoti hai. Is ke molecules sirf mass points hain jo aik doosre par force nahi lagate, is liye P.E. nahi hoti. Lihaza ideal gas ki internal energy aam tor par molecules ki translational K.E. hai.

Temperature se taalluq: kinetic theory ke mutabiq gas molecule ki average kinetic energy
⟨½mv²⟩ = (3/2) k_B T
jahan k_B Boltzmann constant hai. Fi molecule average K.E. T ke mutanasib hai, is liye ideal gas ki internal energy us ke absolute temperature ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai. Temperature ka barhna androoni kinetic energy ke izafe ko zahir karta hai, jo heat jazb karne se ho sakta hai.

Doosri tabdeeliyan: internal energy aur temperature adiabatic dabao ya phailao (heat ke len den ke baghair) se bhi badalte hain; phase ki tabdeeli mein heat temperature badle baghair halat badalti hai. Diatomic molecule mein rotational aur vibrational energy bhi hoti hai.

Function of state: internal energy raaste par nahi, sirf system ki ibtidai aur aakhri halat par munhasir hai. Gravitational P.E. ki tarah sirf internal energy ki tabdeeli aham hai, mukammal qeemat nahi.

book_ref.quote: So, the internal energy of an ideal gas system is generally the translational K.E. of its molecules.

blocks.prompt:
10 Using k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ and Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³, find (i) the average kinetic energy of a molecule of an ideal gas at 127 °C (ii) the total translational kinetic energy of one mole of the gas at this temperature (iii) the Celsius temperature at which the average kinetic energy would be twice that in (i). (3 marks)
(k_B = 1.38 × 10⁻²³ J K⁻¹ aur Nₐ = 6.02 × 10²³ le kar (i) 127 °C par ideal gas ke molecule ki average kinetic energy (ii) is temperature par gas ke aik mole ki kul translational kinetic energy (iii) woh Celsius temperature jis par average kinetic energy (i) se dugni ho, nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Average K.E. = (3/2) k_B T, T kelvin mein; aik mole mein Nₐ molecules; K.E. ∝ T.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, the rise in temperature of an object reflects an increase in the internal kinetic energy

steps: K.E. ∝ T, is liye dugni K.E. ke liye T = 2 × 400 = 800 K = 800 − 273 = 527 °C

blocks.prompt:
11 Explain the sign convention for heat and work in thermodynamics. Derive an expression for the work done by a gas expanding slowly at constant pressure in a cylinder fitted with a frictionless piston, and show how it is related to the P-V graph. (5 marks)
(Thermodynamics mein heat aur work ka sign convention samjhayein. Be-ragar piston wale cylinder mein sabit pressure par aahista phailti gas ke work ka formula nikalein, aur dikhayein ke iska P-V graph se kya taalluq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Heat aur work: dono energy ki muntaqili hain. Yeh khayal pehle steam engine par laagu hua jahan heat andar jaati aur work bahar aata hai, is liye andar aane wali heat aur bahar jane wala work musbat hain. System ka mahaul par kiya work musbat; mahaul ka system par kiya work manfi. System mein aane wali heat Q internal energy barha sakti hai, system se work karwa sakti hai, ya dono.

Derivation: aik cylinder mein gas band hai jis mein cross-sectional area A wala harkat karne wala be-ragar piston hai (Fig. 6.4-a). Equilibrium mein gas volume V gherti hai aur deewaron aur piston par pressure P dalti hai. Piston par gas ki force
F = PA
Gas ΔV tak bohat aahista phailti hai taake equilibrium mein rahe (Fig. 6.4-b). Piston chhota faasla Δy upar jaye to gas ka work
W = FΔy = PAΔy
Chunke AΔy = ΔV (volume ki tabdeeli),
W = PΔV ... (6.4)

P-V graph: sabit pressure par P-V graph P ki unchai par ufuqi lakeer hai. Ibtidai aur aakhri volume ke darmiyan is ke neeche ka area P × ΔV hai, jo work ke barabar hai (Fig. 6.5). Is liye work P-V graph ke neeche ke area se nikala ja sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: We can express the work in terms of directly measurable variables.

blocks.prompt:
12 A gas at a constant pressure of 1.5 × 10⁵ Pa is enclosed by a frictionless piston of area 0.050 m². On heating, the piston moves up slowly by 12 cm. Find (i) the force on the piston (ii) the change in volume (iii) the work done by the gas. (3 marks)
(1.5 × 10⁵ Pa ke sabit pressure par gas 0.050 m² area wale be-ragar piston se band hai. Garam karne par piston aahista 12 cm upar jata hai. (i) piston par force (ii) volume ki tabdeeli (iii) gas ka work nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: F = PA, ΔV = AΔy, W = PΔV; work musbat hai kyunke gas karti hai.

book_ref.quote: In equilibrium, the system occupies volume V, and exerts a pressure P on the walls of the cylinder

blocks.prompt:
13 State the first law of thermodynamics and obtain its equation Q = ΔU + W. Show that it is a form of the law of conservation of energy, and explain the warming of air in a bicycle pump with a blocked outlet (Fig. 6.6) in its light. (5 marks)
(First law of thermodynamics bayan karein aur us ki equation Q = ΔU + W hasil karein. Dikhayein ke yeh energy ki baqa ke qanoon ki aik shakal hai, aur band outlet wale cycle pump (Fig. 6.6) mein hawa ke garam hone ki is ki roshni mein wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Equation: jab system ko heat di jaye to us ki internal energy barhti hai (temperature, pressure barhna ya halat badalna). Agar saath hi substance phail kar mahaul par work W kare to darkaar heat Q woh hai jo internal energy ko U₁ se U₂ tak badalne ke liye chahiye, jama kiya gaya work:
Q = (U₂ − U₁) + W
Q = ΔU + W ... (6.5)
Is liye ΔU = U₂ − U₁ = Q − W.

Bayan: kisi bhi thermodynamic amal mein jab system ko heat Q di jaye to yeh energy system mein jama internal energy ke izafe ΔU aur system ke mahaul par kiye gaye work W ki shakal mein zahir hoti hai.

Energy ki baqa: energy aik shakal se doosri mein badal sakti hai magar isolated system ki kul energy sabit rehti hai. First law yahi kehta hai: di gayi heat poori ki poori internal energy aur work mein shumar hoti hai; energy na paida hoti hai na khatam. Yeh energy ki tamam shaklon aur har amal par laagu hai, jaise chemical reactions, electrical systems aur nuclear reactions.

Cycle pump: band outlet wale cycle pump mein outlet se thermocouple guzara gaya hai jo millivoltmeter se jura hai aur hawa ka temperature dikhata hai (Fig. 6.6). Piston tezi se dabane par dhakelne wali force hawa par work karti hai. Yeh work hawa ki internal energy barhata hai jo temperature ke izafe se nazar aata hai.

Doosri misaal: insani jism (metabolism) mein kiya gaya work internal energy kam karta hai (ΔU = Q − W) aur khana use barqarar rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: When heat is added to a system there is an increase in the internal energy

blocks.prompt:
14 A gas in a cylinder is kept at a constant pressure of 1.2 × 10⁴ N m⁻² by a piston of area 0.050 m². When 80 J of heat is supplied slowly, the piston rises by 6.0 cm. Find (i) the work done by the gas (ii) the change in its internal energy. (3 marks)
(Cylinder mein gas 0.050 m² area wale piston se 1.2 × 10⁴ N m⁻² ke sabit pressure par hai. 80 J heat aahista di jaye to piston 6.0 cm upar uthta hai. (i) gas ka work (ii) us ki internal energy mein tabdeeli nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: W = PAΔy nikalein, phir first law se ΔU = Q − W.

book_ref.quote: The change in internal energy is found from first law of thermodynamics

blocks.prompt:
15 Apply the first law of thermodynamics to (i) an isothermal process (ii) an adiabatic process of an ideal gas. In each case explain what happens to the temperature and internal energy, write the P-V relation, and give the conditions under which the process takes place. (5 marks)
(First law of thermodynamics ko ideal gas ke (i) isothermal amal (ii) adiabatic amal par laagu karein. Har soorat mein temperature aur internal energy ka kya hota hai, P-V taalluq likhein, aur woh sharait batayein jin mein yeh amal hota hai.)
blocks.explanation:
(i) Isothermal amal: sabit temperature par hone wala amal, is liye Boyle's law laagu hota hai. Gas isothermal tor par phaile ya dabe to
P₁V₁ = P₂V₂
Ideal gas ke molecules ki P.E. sifar hai, is liye internal energy sirf temperature par munhasir hai jo sabit hai: ΔU = 0. First law Q = ΔU + W ban jata hai
Q = W
Agar gas phail kar work W kare to use heat Q deni parti hai. Heat ki muntaqili mein waqt lagta hai, is liye phailao ya dabao aahista hona chahiye. Curve isotherm hai (Fig. 6.7-a).

(ii) Adiabatic amal: heat na andar aati hai na bahar, is liye ΔQ = 0 aur first law deta hai
W = −ΔU
Agar gas phail kar bairooni work kare to yeh us ke molecules ki internal energy ke kharch par hota hai, is liye temperature girta hai. Adiabatic dabao temperature barhata hai kyunke gas par work hota hai. Temperature sabit nahi rehta, is liye
PV^γ = constant
jahan γ sabit pressure aur sabit volume wali molar specific heats ki nisbat hai. Adiabatic tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab gas tezi se phaile ya dabe, khaas taur par insulated cylinder mein. Curve adiabat hai (Fig. 6.7-b).
Misalein: phate tyre se hawa ka tezi se nikalna; aawaz ki lehar guzarne par hawa ka tezi se phailna aur dabna; fizaa mein badal banna.

book_ref.quote: when gas expands or compresses isothermally, the product of its pressure and volume during the process remains constant

rows: Heat ka len den nahi; ΔQ = 0.

blocks.prompt:
16 An ideal gas at 1.0 × 10⁵ Pa occupies 6.0 L. It is compressed isothermally to 4.0 L, and 180 J of work is done on it. Find (i) the final pressure (ii) the change in internal energy and the heat exchanged (iii) the change in internal energy if the same 180 J of work were done on the gas adiabatically instead. (3 marks)
(1.0 × 10⁵ Pa par ideal gas 6.0 L gherti hai. Use isothermal tor par 4.0 L tak dabaya jata hai aur us par 180 J work hota hai. (i) aakhri pressure (ii) internal energy ki tabdeeli aur heat ka len den (iii) agar yahi 180 J work adiabatic tor par kiya jata to internal energy ki tabdeeli nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Isothermal: Boyle's law aur ΔU = 0, Q = W. Adiabatic: Q = 0, ΔU = −W. Gas par kiya work manfi hai.

book_ref.quote: If P₁, V₁ are initial pressure and volume whereas P₂, V₂ are pressure and volume after the isothermal change

steps: Isothermal: ΔU = 0; W = −180 J (gas par work), is liye Q = W = −180 J: 180 J heat gas se nikalti hai
Adiabatic: Q = 0, ΔU = −W = −(−180) = +180 J, is liye temperature barhta hai
blocks.final_answer: (i) 1.5 × 10⁵ Pa (ii) ΔU = 0, 180 J heat kharij (iii) ΔU = +180 J

blocks.prompt:
17 What is a heat engine? With the help of a schematic diagram (Fig. 6.8), explain its working and show that W = Q₁ − Q₂. State Kelvin's form of the second law of thermodynamics and explain why a source and a sink at different temperatures are essential. (5 marks)
(Heat engine kya hai? Schematic diagram (Fig. 6.8) ki madad se us ka kaam samjhayein aur dikhayein ke W = Q₁ − Q₂. Second law of thermodynamics ka Kelvin statement bayan karein aur samjhayein ke mukhtalif temperature wale source aur sink kyun zaroori hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Heat engine: aisa aala jo kuch thermal energy, aam tor par jalte fuel se, mechanical work mein badalta hai. Sab se pehla steam engine tha, jo is mushahide se bana ke dhake ubalte bartan mein bhaap dhakkan ko dhakelti hai. Yeh dauri amal mein kaam karta hai, heat ko zyada temperature wale reservoir se kam temperature wale reservoir tak le jata hai aur us ka zyada se zyada hissa work banata hai.

Kaam (Fig. 6.8): engine temperature T₁ wale source se heat Q₁ leta hai, work W karta hai, aur T₂ wale thande reservoir ko heat Q₂ deta hai. Working substance cycle poora kar ke ibtidai halat mein aa jata hai, is liye ΔU = 0. First law se kul work kul jazb shuda heat ke barabar hai:
W = Q₁ − Q₂
Amalan petrol engine taqreeban 25% aur diesel engine 35 se 40% heat ko work banate hain; baqi fizaa mein nikal jaati hai.

Second law ki zaroorat: first law kehta hai ke heat barabar work ban sakti hai magar sharait par khamosh hai. Second law batata hai ke heat kin halaat mein work banti hai aur heat ka bahao kis simt mein hai.

Kelvin statement: aisa amal banana na-mumkin hai jo aik hi reservoir se li gayi heat ko working system mein koi tabdeeli chhore baghair poora work bana de.

Source aur sink: aik akela heat reservoir, chahe kitni energy rakhe, work nahi kar sakta. Is liye mukhtalif temperature wale do jism zaroori hain: zyada temperature ka source aur kam temperature ka sink jahan heat di jaye. Isi liye samandar aur fizaa ki bohat zyada heat istemal nahi ho sakti: un se thanda koi reservoir nahi.

book_ref.quote: Before initiating the discussion on formal statement of the second law of thermodynamics

blocks.prompt:
18 Answer both parts. (A) An engine absorbs 2000 J of heat from the source and expels 1500 J to the sink in each cycle. Find the work done per cycle and the efficiency. (B) A diesel engine converts 38% of the heat it absorbs into work. If it absorbs 5000 J, find the work done and the heat expelled. (3 marks)
(Dono hisse hal karein. (A) Aik engine har cycle mein source se 2000 J heat leta aur sink ko 1500 J deta hai. Har cycle ka work aur efficiency nikalein. (B) Aik diesel engine jazb shuda heat ka 38% work banata hai. Agar woh 5000 J le to work aur kharij heat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Cycle mein W = Q₁ − Q₂ aur efficiency = W/Q₁.

book_ref.quote: It has been observed that petrol engines convert roughly

steps: Hissa A: W = Q₁ − Q₂ = 2000 − 1500 = 500 J
blocks.final_answer: A: W = 500 J, efficiency 25%. B: W = 1900 J, Q₂ = 3100 J

blocks.prompt:
19 Describe the four steps of the Carnot cycle on a PV diagram (Fig. 6.9). Show that the net work done in one cycle is Q₁ − Q₂, and obtain the efficiency of a Carnot engine in terms of the temperatures of its reservoirs. Explain why this efficiency can never be 100%, and state Carnot's theorem. (5 marks)
(PV diagram (Fig. 6.9) par Carnot cycle ke chaar marhale bayan karein. Dikhayein ke aik cycle ka kul work Q₁ − Q₂ hai, aur Carnot engine ki efficiency reservoirs ke temperatures ki shakal mein hasil karein. Samjhayein ke yeh efficiency kabhi 100% kyun nahi ho sakti, aur Carnot's theorem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Carnot engine: Sadi Carnot (1824) ne aisa misali engine bayan kiya jo sirf isothermal aur adiabatic amal istemal karta hai. Do reservoirs ke darmiyan misali reversible cycle mein chalne wala engine sab se zyada efficient hota hai.

Marhale (Fig. 6.9), ideal gas working substance:
AB: T₁ par isothermal phailao, garam reservoir se heat Q₁ jazb.
BC: adiabatic phailao jab tak temperature T₂ tak gir jaye.
CD: T₂ par isothermal dabao, thande reservoir ko heat Q₂ kharij.
DA: adiabatic dabao, T₁ par ibtidai halat mein wapsi.
Har waqt thermal aur mechanical equilibrium qaim rehta hai, is liye har amal reversible hai.

Kul work: substance ibtidai halat mein wapas aata hai, is liye ΔU = 0. Kul jazb heat Q = Q₁ − Q₂. First law Q = ΔU + W se:
W = Q₁ − Q₂ (kyunke ΔU = 0)
Yeh PV diagram par ABCDA ke ghere hue area ke barabar bhi hai.

Efficiency: η = output (work)/input (energy)
η = (Q₁ − Q₂)/Q₁ ... (6.6)
Isothermal phailao ya dabao mein muntaqil energy kelvin temperature ke mutanasib hai, is liye Q₁ ∝ T₁ aur Q₂ ∝ T₂:
η = (T₁ − T₂)/T₁ = 1 − T₂/T₁ ... (6.7)
Percentage efficiency = (1 − T₂/T₁) × 100

100% kyun nahi: η sirf reservoirs ke temperatures par munhasir hai, working substance par nahi; temperature ka farq jitna zyada, efficiency utni zyada. η = 1 sirf tab jab T₂ = 0 K ho, aur aise reservoir dastyab nahi, is liye η hamesha aik se kam hai.

Carnot's theorem: koi heat engine unhi do temperatures ke darmiyan chalne wale Carnot engine se zyada efficient nahi ho sakta. Wasee shakal: unhi do temperatures ke darmiyan tamam Carnot engines ki efficiency barabar hai, working substance koi bhi ho.

book_ref.quote: A Carnot cycle using an ideal gas as the working substance is shown on PV diagram

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Carnot cycle yaad karne ka tareeqa: 'phailao, phailao, dabao, dabao' aur har jore mein pehle isothermal phir adiabatic. Heat sirf isothermal marhalon (AB mein Q₁ andar, CD mein Q₂ bahar) mein len den hoti hai; adiabatic marhalon (BC, DA) mein sirf temperature badalta hai.

blocks.prompt:
20 A Carnot engine works between a boiler at 227 °C and a sink at 27 °C. It absorbs 1500 J of heat from the boiler in each cycle. Find (i) its efficiency (ii) the work done per cycle (iii) the heat rejected to the sink per cycle. (3 marks)
(Aik Carnot engine 227 °C ke boiler aur 27 °C ke sink ke darmiyan chalta hai. Woh har cycle mein boiler se 1500 J heat leta hai. (i) us ki efficiency (ii) har cycle ka work (iii) har cycle mein sink ko di gayi heat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Kelvin mein badlein, η = 1 − T₂/T₁ lagayein, phir W = ηQ₁ aur Q₂ = Q₁ − W.

book_ref.quote: What is the maximum possible efficiency?

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain how a refrigerator works as a heat engine operating in reverse (Fig. 6.10). Show that the work needed is W = Q_H − Q_C. Define its co-efficient of performance and express it in terms of heats and in terms of the temperatures of the two reservoirs. (5 marks)
(Samjhayein ke refrigerator ulte chalne wale heat engine ki tarah kaise kaam karta hai (Fig. 6.10). Dikhayein ke darkaar work W = Q_H − Q_C hai. Us ke co-efficient of performance ki definition likhein aur use heat ki shakal mein aur dono reservoirs ke temperatures ki shakal mein likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Refrigerator: aisa aala jo kisi jism ka temperature us ke mahaul se kam rakhta hai. Yeh dauri amal mein chalta hai magar heat engine ke ulat (Fig. 6.10): thande reservoir se heat leta aur garam reservoir ko deta hai. Refrigerator mein system par work hota hai, jabke heat engine mein system work karta hai. Yeh second law ke Clausius statement ki buniyad par kaam karta hai.

Kaam: compressor Low Temperature Reservoir (LTR) se heat Q_C kheenchta hai aur bairooni work W ki madad se High Temperature Reservoir (HTR) mein phenkta hai. Energy ki baqa se HTR ko di gayi heat
Q_H = Q_C + W, ya W = Q_H − Q_C
Bunyadi maqsad yeh hai ke kam se kam work W se LTR se zyada se zyada heat Q_C nikali jaye.

Co-efficient of performance: LTR se nikali heat aur kiye gaye work ki nisbat:
E = Q_C/W = Q_C/(Q_H − Q_C)
Behtar refrigerator kam mechanical work ya bijli se zyada heat nikalta hai, is liye us ki E bari hoti hai.

Temperature ki shakal mein: chunke Q ∝ T, T₁ thande reservoir aur T₂ garam reservoir ka temperature ho to
E = T₁/(T₂ − T₁)
(Note: yahan T₁ thanda hissa hai, Carnot engine ke ulat jahan T₁ garam hissa hai.)

book_ref.quote: It operates in a cyclic process but in reverse as that of the heat engine

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Engine aur refrigerator mein T₁, T₂ ke naam ulte hain: Carnot engine ke formula mein T₁ garam aur T₂ thanda hai, jabke chapter ke refrigerator formula E = T₁/(T₂ − T₁) mein T₁ thanda (freezer) aur T₂ garam (kamra) hai. Hamesha pehle likh lein ke kaun sa temperature thanda hai.

blocks.prompt:
22 An ideal refrigerator keeps its freezer at −13 °C while the room is at 27 °C. Find (i) its co-efficient of performance (ii) the work needed to remove 1300 J of heat from the freezer (iii) the heat rejected to the room. (3 marks)
(Misali refrigerator apna freezer −13 °C par rakhta hai jabke kamra 27 °C par hai. (i) us ka co-efficient of performance (ii) freezer se 1300 J heat nikalne ke liye darkaar work (iii) kamre ko di gayi heat nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: E = T₁/(T₂ − T₁) lagayein, T₁ thanda hissa kelvin mein, phir W = Q_C/E aur Q_H = Q_C + W.

book_ref.quote: Co-efficient of performance = T₁/(T₂ − T₁)

blocks.prompt:
23 Define the change in entropy of a system. Show that when heat flows through a conducting rod from a hot reservoir to a cold reservoir, the net entropy increases. State the second law in terms of entropy, and explain the relation of entropy with molecular disorder and with the degradation of energy. (5 marks)
(System ki entropy mein tabdeeli ki definition likhein. Dikhayein ke jab heat conducting rod ke zariye garam reservoir se thande reservoir mein jaye to kul entropy barhti hai. Entropy ki shakal mein second law bayan karein, aur entropy ka molecular disorder aur energy ki degradation se taalluq samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Entropy: Rudolph Clausius ne 1856 mein second law ko miqdaari buniyad dene ke liye pesh ki; P, V, T aur U ke saath system ki halat bayan karne wala aik aur variable. Agar system reversible amal mein absolute temperature T par heat ΔQ jazb kare to us ki entropy ka izafa
ΔS = ΔQ/T ... (6.8)
Internal energy ki tarah entropy ki tabdeeli aham hai. Heat dene par ΔS musbat aur heat nikalne par manfi hoti hai.

Rod se heat ka bahao: heat Q, T₁ wale reservoir se T₂ wale reservoir mein jaati hai, T₁ > T₂.
Garam reservoir (heat khota hai) ki entropy Q/T₁ kam hoti hai.
Thande reservoir (heat leta hai) ki entropy Q/T₂ barhti hai.
Chunke T₁ > T₂, Q/T₂ > Q/T₁, is liye kul tabdeeli (Q/T₂ − Q/T₁) musbat hai.
Yani tamam qudrati amal mein jahan heat aik system se doosre mein jaati hai, entropy mein kul izafa hota hai.

Entropy ki shakal mein second law: agar system qudrati amal se guzre to woh us simt mein jata hai jis se system aur mahaul ki kul entropy barhe. Reversible amal mein entropy sabit rehti hai aur har irreversible amal mein barhti hai.

Entropy aur disorder: qudrati amal zyada be-tarteebi ki taraf jaate hain. Garam se thande ki taraf irreversible heat ka bahao molecules ki garam aur thande hisson mein tarteeb khatam karta hai; heat dene se molecules ki speed aur be-tarteebi barhti hai; free expansion se molecules ki position mein be-tarteebi barhti hai. Har soorat mein entropy barhti hai.

Energy ki degradation: har baar entropy barhne par kuch heat ko work banane ka mauqa zaya ho jata hai (maslan garam aur thanda paani milana). Energy zaya nahi hoti magar aise darje se jahan zyada work mil sakta hai, aise darje par aa jaati hai jahan kam ya koi mufeed work nahi hota, aur aakhir thermal energy ban jaati hai. Tamam systems ko mila kar kainaat ki entropy hamesha barhti hai.

book_ref.quote: It follows that in all natural processes where heat flows from one system to another

blocks.prompt:
24 Find the entropy change in two cases: (i) 0.25 kg of ice at 0 °C melts into water at 0 °C (L_f = 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹); (ii) 3000 J of heat flows through a rod from a reservoir at 500 K to a reservoir at 300 K (net change). (3 marks)
(Do suraton mein entropy ki tabdeeli nikalein: (i) 0 °C par 0.25 kg barf pighal kar 0 °C ka paani banti hai (L_f = 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹); (ii) 3000 J heat aik rod ke zariye 500 K wale reservoir se 300 K wale reservoir mein jaati hai (kul tabdeeli).)
blocks.explanation: Pighalna sabit T par hai, is liye ΔS = mL_f/T. Heat ke bahao mein garam reservoir ka −Q/T₁ aur thande ka +Q/T₂ jama karein.

book_ref.quote: Latent heat of fusion of ice L_f = 3.36 × 10⁵ J kg⁻¹.
